milestone: N5 second bounded activation — full lifetime, approved UI, corrected liveness
objective: Complete what OPENDITOO-M9-ACTIVATION-001 could not: a full-lifetime bounded session on the exact unit, driving the operator-approved three-MCP page, with the worker-liveness defect fixed. Adds live evidence for change-only pacing and coalescing, and a stock-yield case if a control is touched.
why_this_shape: 001 proved the display renders (operator-confirmed) but ended at 30.4 s on our own defect, so the interesting behaviour was never exercised. This changes two things deliberately: the corrected heartbeat liveness path, and the approved UI. Rate, packets, target, connection shape and stop policy are unchanged from the accepted values.

target.pairing_precheck: authenticated exact target required before any socket is created

transport.one_controller_rule: the Android app must be disconnected for the whole session; OpenTivoo's runtime, tasks and port 8779 are untouched

build.installed_identity_note: The installed Host predates the heartbeat fix and would reproduce 001's failure. `refresh_openditoo_day1_host.ps1 -Apply` MUST be re-run and the installed hash re-verified before this experiment. Because the Release build is not byte-reproducible, freeze host_dll_sha256 from the artifact actually installed at that point, not from this file.
build.build_is_not_byte_reproducible: Two Release builds of identical source produced different DLL hashes (d3ece014...a042a then a0f2fa1c...f2762). The build is not deterministic, so a build hash is only meaningful when taken from the artifact actually installed. That is what is frozen here.
build.ui_design: Operator-approved three-MCP page from the supplied handoff package: L/mushroom, O/bunny, W/skull, blue activity override. host/activity_ui_data.py is DERIVED from assets/ui/reference/ and the offline suite re-renders all eight approved mockups pixel-for-pixel.

session.activation_source: the three MCP audit sources (optiplex_lab, optiplex_mcp, wsl_mcp), rendered by host/activity_render.py as the approved MCP page
session.shape: one connection; collect once per second; render; send ONLY when the rendered frame changes, never faster than one frame start per 1118 ms; observe the link continuously including while idle; then close
session.semantic_evidence: No new command semantics. Every frame is the same stock-derived three-packet 0x44 transaction proven at M5/M6 and repeated at M8; only the pixels differ.

budgets.derivation: 300 s at a 1118 ms minimum frame interval admits at most 269 frame starts. Packets are 3 per frame by construction. 203 bytes is the measured worst-case frame over all 512 status/activity render combinations of the approved page (max image packet 188 bytes at 14 palette colours, plus the two stock preambles at 7 and 8 bytes). The previous design's figure was 191; the approved page is slightly larger. A quiet session sends far less: this is a ceiling, not a target.
budgets.expected_realistic_frames: on the order of 10-60, driven by actual activity; an unchanged scene sends nothing at all

stop_immediately_on: any unsolicited state report on the link (canvas is no longer ours)
any inbound bytes that do not parse as exactly one valid wrapped report
any ACK that is not our wrapped 0x44 shape with a single payload byte
any send that does not complete in full
pairing precheck failure or any conflicting controller on the link
the worker falling silent for longer than the Host's grace period
stop_policy.on_ambiguous_outcome: stop sending, close the link, record completed and unknown bytes and the last known display state, and report. Do NOT resend, reconnect, reclaim the screen or power-cycle before the result is recorded.
stop_policy.recovery: operator-initiated only, after the outcome is recorded, using documented exact-Ditoo controls. Returning to stock is an operator action, never a command we send.
stop_policy.operator_abort: the session is short and supervised; if it looks wrong, stop it with `session-close` or power off the Ditoo rather than letting it continue.

persistence_analysis.basis: M6.4 power cycle returned the unit to stock software and the default clock
persistence_analysis.not_claimed: absence of any non-volatile write. Sending more distinct images than before does not test that either.
persistence_analysis.new_risk_vs_m8: none identified: identical command, identical packet shape, same session shape, same rate ceiling. No new command id, no save/publish/upload, no gallery interaction.

expected_observations.transport: one connection; three application packets per sent frame; one wrapped 0x44 ACK each; clean local close; zero reconnects
expected_observations.physical: the letters L O W on rows 5-9 in per-source status colour, 5x5 mushroom / bunny / skull icons on rows 11-15, and a blue chevron crown on rows 0-2 above any column with fresh activity, whose letter and icon accent turn blue with it
expected_observations.idle_silence: during any period with no status change and no activity, ZERO packets are sent
expected_observations.animation_expectation: the approved four-stage blue pulse is NOT animated. At ~1118 ms per frame it would be decimated to noise, so the crown is static while activity is fresh. Expect the blue override to appear and disappear, not to shimmer.
expected_observations.ack_payload: recorded per frame, never asserted. It is not a success constant.

acceptance_criteria.transport_acceptance: planned versus actual frames, packets, bytes and ACKs agree; one connection; no retry; no reconnect; clean close; the session reaches its own lifetime rather than an unintended terminal
acceptance_criteria.visual_acceptance: the operator confirms the approved page renders: L O W letters, the three icons, correct status colours, and a blue crown plus blue letter/icon on a column that sees activity. ACKs do not establish this.
acceptance_criteria.change_only_acceptance: the operator confirms at least one quiet interval where the display held still, AND at least one observed change; recorded frame count materially below the budget ceiling
acceptance_criteria.pacing_acceptance: no two frame starts closer than 1118 ms in the recorded timings
acceptance_criteria.stock_yield_acceptance: if a physical control is used, the session stops, no further frame is sent, display state becomes unknown_not_ours, and no reclaim frame is sent. If no takeover occurs, record NOT TESTED.
acceptance_criteria.liveness_regression: the session must NOT end with `worker_silent` while the worker is alive; that is the exact 001 failure this experiment is testing the fix for
acceptance_criteria.collection_survives: after the display stops for any reason, activity-status still collects
acceptance_criteria.authority_is_consumed: the claim file and Host ledger both record this id terminal; a second run is refused
not_established_by_this_experiment: any rate above the accepted ~1118 ms ceiling
menu-takeover behaviour (0xBD) unless it happens to occur and is recorded

preconditions: `refresh_openditoo_day1_host.ps1 -Apply` re-run (the installed Host predates the heartbeat fix), and the installed DLL hash re-verified and frozen into build.host_dll_sha256
the installed binary re-run against tests/receive_assembler_cases.json: HOST_SELFTEST_PASS
`python3 cli/openditoo.py activity-probe` showing the sources reachable
`python3 scripts/verify_day1_offline.py` PASS at the commit being run
operator present and watching the unit for the whole session

implementation_gate.host_change_required: the heartbeat route and corrected liveness; implemented and built, NOT yet installed
implementation_gate.status: implemented offline; awaiting install and grant

authority.grant_scope_requested: ONE execution of this exact bounded session: up to 300 seconds, change-only frames at no faster than one frame start per 1118 ms, at most 269 frames / 807 packets / 54607 application bytes, one connection, no retry, no reconnect, no reclaim. Not continuous display, not unattended operation, not installation-time transmission, not a higher rate, not a second attempt.
authority.note: Grants nothing as written. `session-check` reports TRANSMISSION_AUTHORITY_MISSING and `activity-session` exits 30 until an operator fills granted_by, grant_text and expires_at.

explicitly_out_of_scope: any rate above the accepted ceiling
reconnecting or resending after any fault
sending a frame to reclaim the screen after a takeover
any new command id, command enumeration or raw send
firmware update, persistent upload, service/MassBoot entry or teardown

supersedes.why: Its grant is consumed and its frozen code hashes are history. This is a NEW manifest with a new id, not a re-arming of that one.
carried_forward: one connection, no retry, no reconnect, no reclaim
